recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-30872 unless PA later chooses to revise the broader Patient financial-context guidance from later issues.
issue_request: FHIR-30872 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Administration change request for R5 asking the Patient Scope and Usage section to clarify that Patient can be used for financial use cases where the person may be an insurance subscriber or policy holder rather than an actual patient within a facility.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by commit 715cfb05586732de6e57c8f9b0bf5b15b622159e, which added 'Tracking financial services (e.g. insurance subscriber/policy holder)' to source/patient/patient-introduction.xml. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key audit commit for FHIR-30872 existed on the combined branch before this reconciliation.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists patient=Patient as an active resource, placing source/patient/patient-introduction.xml in current build scope. Later Patient work, including FHIR-40295 and FHIR-42732, did not reverse the seed decision; it added Boundaries and Relationships/current financial-context guidance that Patient may be appropriate for subscriber, guarantor, beneficiary, and related financial actor roles.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current Patient introduction already contains the approved FHIR-30872 bullet and additional current-source clarification, so editing source would be redundant rather than corrective.

related_jiras.note: Added the Patient Boundaries and Relationships section that now also names subscriber, member, guarantor, and financial actors; useful context but broader than the seed audit.
Later PA clarification about Account/Coverage financial use of Patient instances supports the conclusion that the FHIR-30872 clarification remains correct.
